description:
Use this when the user asks about one area of life — when marriage, children, career, money, property or another area is in focus, or what a given stretch of years holds for it.
One life area across the whole life: the planets that govern it on this chart, every period that bears on it (past and future, with dates, ages and why that planet governs it), each marked `primary` when the area is in focus or `also` when the period only touches it, and what is in focus now and next, in plain words. Pass `window` to get only the periods that overlap a date range. It is the same reading as the whole-life reading, cut to one area, so the two never disagree. Health is read only as periods to give extra care, never as illness or lifespan. Deterministic: no language model is called. The birth time is required.
Cost: 3 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"area":"relationship","window":{"from":"2026-01-01","to":"2031-12-31"}}

birthData.description: The person's birth data. The time is required: every period depends on the rising sign.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

window.description: Optional: only periods overlapping this date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the whole life.

name: get_domain_timeline

area.description: The life area: what governs it, and every period (within the window, if one was given).

because.description: Why this planet governs the area on this chart, e.g. "lord of the 7th".

care.description: Health only, in-focus periods only: the body areas the tradition links to the period and the matching check-up. Not repeated in `words`.

classical.description: The classical grounds behind the period, in plain words: the chapter (mahādaśā) lord, the period lord's nakṣatra (star) lord and its full aspect, where they bear on this area. Not repeated in `words`.

focus.description: primary: the area is in focus (the period lord rules or occupies the area's primary house, or is its natural significator; a node acts for its sign lord). also: the period only touches the area through a wider significator. `now`, `next` and the summary use primary periods only.

shownFromAge.description: Periods before this age are not shown for the area.

window.description: The window asked for, or null for the whole life.

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

title: Life-area timeline
